divisions.title: Foundations
divisions.summary: Israel fails to drive out the nations; a generation forgets the LORD.

divisions.title: Ehud
divisions.summary: Ehud assassinates Eglon and delivers Israel from Moab.

divisions.title: Deborah
divisions.summary: Deborah and Barak defeat Sisera; Jael drives the tent peg.

divisions.title: Gideon
divisions.summary: Three hundred men, torches, and trumpets rout Midian.

divisions.title: Abimelech
divisions.summary: Abimelech murders his brothers and establishes himself as king.

divisions.title: Jephthah
divisions.summary: Jephthah defeats Ammon but his vow costs him everything.

divisions.title: Samson
divisions.summary: The strongest judge, undone by his own appetites, wins his greatest victory in death.

divisions.title: Collapse
divisions.summary: Idolatry and atrocity: everyone does what is right in their own eyes.
